name: doppel-sdk
description: Doppel SDK monorepo: core client and agent claw

scripts.pack:check: pnpm run build && pnpm publish -r --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public
scripts.docker:push: sh -c 'set -e; ref="${GCP_CLAW_DOCKER_IMAGE:-}"; if [ -z "$ref" ]; then echo "docker:push: set GCP_CLAW_DOCKER_IMAGE to your Artifact Registry image (e.g. us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT/REPO/doppel-claw:latest)" >&2; exit 1; fi; docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 --push -t "$ref" .'
